title: GPT-6 Astra has gained the ability to drive a car
summary: A Hacker News discussion about a claim that GPT-6 Astra can drive a car, linking to drivingbench.com. The 295-point thread with 228 comments likely debates the benchmark's validity, the plausibility of an LLM controlling a vehicle, and what 'driving' actually entails for a language model.
